hebrewText: יְהוָה֙ כַּ/גִּבּ֣וֹר יֵצֵ֔א כְּ/אִ֥ישׁ מִלְחָמ֖וֹת יָעִ֣יר קִנְאָ֑ה יָרִ֨יעַ֙ אַף יַצְרִ֔יחַ עַל אֹיְבָ֖י/ו יִתְגַּבָּֽר

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
champion, chief, [idiom] excel, giant, man, mighty (man, one), strong (man), valiant man.

tokens.bdb: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, appear, [idiom] assuredly, bear out, [idiom] begotten, break out, bring forth (out, up), carry out, come (abroad, out, thereat, without), [phrase] be condemned, depart(-ing, -ure), draw forth, in the end, escape, exact, fail, fall (out), fetch forth (out), get away (forth, hence, out), (able to, cause to, let) go abroad (forth, on, out), going out, grow, have forth (out), issue out, lay (lie) out, lead out, pluck out, proceed, pull out, put away, be risen, [idiom] scarce, send with commandment, shoot forth, spread, spring out, stand out, [idiom] still, [idiom] surely, take forth (out), at any time, [idiom] to (and fro), utter.

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.bdb: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare)

tokens.kjv: (a-) wake(-n, up), lift up (self), [idiom] master, raise (up), stir up (self).

tokens.bdb: to mar (especially by breaking); figuratively, to split the ears (with sound), i.e. shout (for alarm or joy)
tokens.kjv: blow an alarm, cry (alarm, aloud, out), destroy, make a joyful noise, smart, shout (for joy), sound an alarm, triumph.

tokens.bdb: meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.kjv: also, [phrase] although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, [phrase] how much less (more, rather than), moreover, with, yea.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.enLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.explanation: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.explanationEn: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though

tokens.bdb: to be clear (in tone, i.e. shrill), i.e. to whoop
above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: to be strong; by implication, to prevail, act insolently
tokens.kjv: exceed, confirm, be great, be mighty, prevail, put to more (strength), strengthen, be stronger, be valiant.
